text:
Anya (Design): Quick sketch + Qs — proposing we condense the left rail into 3 tiers (Workspace / Product areas / Utilities) and expose an explicit deep-link icon on hover for each leaf item so teams can copy a stable URL. Thoughts?
Mike (Eng): Love the lower density. worried about discoverability for less-used items. how do we show crumbs for flows that live under multiple parents?
Anya (Design): Good point. My thought: keep breadcrumbs tied to the canonical route but allow a secondary 'context' pill e.g., ‘from: Pipelines’ when arriving via a different flow. Not full duplicate nav.
Jess (PM): Real use case: customers linking support tickets need a single canonical link that always lands on the right tab. We should avoid multiple canonical URLs for the same resource.
Sam (Frontend): Implementation Q — if we add a hover deep-link icon, keyboard users need an equivalent: suggested visible affordance on focus + aria-label. Also need to debounce showing copy toast.
Kai (Accessibility): Please ensure the deep-link button is in the TAB order and has descriptive label like "Copy link to Model details". Tooltips alone aren't accessible. Also ensure breadcrumb separators are readable by screen readers (use aria-hidden on visual separators).
Mike (Eng): Routing-wise I propose a URL contract: use query param for context, e.g. /models/:id?from=workflows. canonical = /models/:id (no from). Context param is optional and not canonical. Does that align with product?
Jess (PM): That works. Product wants analytics to capture where users came from so query param is useful. But we need to avoid SEO-ish crawl dupes — not relevant internally but good to be clear.
Anya (Design): UX note: when context param exists, show a subtle pill next to the breadcrumb: "via Workflows" with a close 'x' to dismiss and remove param (update history.replaceState).
Sam (Frontend): Implementation sketch:
```js
// copy deep link
const url = new URL(window.location.href);
url.searchParams.delete('session'); // ephemeral
navigator.clipboard.writeText(url.toString());
showToast('Link copied');
```
Make sure we strip ephemeral params and auth tokens.
Mike (Eng): Agree. We'll maintain a small allowlist of stable params that get preserved when copying. Anything else is removed. routing-bot: create PR template for which params are stable?
routing-bot: PR template created: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/merge-templates#deep-link-params :robot_face:
Kai (Accessibility): Keyboard flow: TAB -> focus on nav item -> press Enter to open -> press Shift+Tab returns. But for copying, we need an ARIA menu on the focused item with a "Copy link" option. That keeps everything keyboard-accessible.
Sam (Frontend): Implementation detail: we can reuse existing popover component to show copy + "Open in new tab" actions. ensure popover traps focus briefly and restores.
Anya (Design): Visual: show small link icon that becomes a button on hover/focus. When clicked, animate a tiny checkmark for success (200ms). Keep contrast high.
Jess (PM): Rollout plan: A/B test with 10% of org then increment. Measure: link copy rate, successful deep-link opens, and support ticket citations. Also watch navigation time for discoverability regressions.
Mike (Eng): Can we add a flag to hide the icon for small screens? Mobile needs simpler nav. Use overflow menu instead.
Anya (Design): Yes — collapse to an overflow kebab on narrow widths. The deep-link action remains in the item menu.
Kai (Accessibility): One more: ensure color contrast for the pill and focus ring meet AA. Also test with high-zoom and screen readers.
Sam (Frontend): I'll draft the component PR and include test cases for keyboard + screen reader text.
Anya (Design): Thanks all — I'll update the sketch and add a tiny interaction spec and copy for the aria-labels. Next sync Thurs 11am. :sparkles: 
Jess (PM): Thanks — adding to the roadmap doc and will add analytics events. :thumbsup:
Mike (Eng): Sounds good. If no objections, I'll schedule an RFC after Sam's PR draft.
Kai (Accessibility): No objections from a11y side.
Anya (Design): Closing here — ping me if you want to pair on edge cases.
